questions.text: The study of Asma Ul Rijal is related to which of the following Islamic sciences?
questions.explanation: The study of Asma Ul Rijal is related to the Islamic science of Hadith. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, hadith terminology classification (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: In the science of Hadith, this refers to a hadith whose chain of narration ends at a Tabi'i. What is this hadith called?
questions.explanation: A hadith whose chain ends at a Tabi'i is called Hadith Maqtu'. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, hadith terminology classification (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: What is the term used for a Hadith that is found in both Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim?
questions.explanation: A Hadith found in both Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim is called Muttafaq Alaih (Agreed Upon). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, hadith terminology classification.

questions.text: Which method is traditionally used by scholars to verify the authenticity of Hadith?

options.C: Cross-referencing with Quran and established Sunnah

questions.explanation: Scholars traditionally verify Hadith authenticity through a combination of Isnad analysis, Matn analysis, and cross-referencing with the Quran and established Sunnah. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, hadith terminology classification.

questions.text: What is the term used for a Hadith where a Sahabi's action was observed by the Prophet (SAW) without any objection?
questions.explanation: The term for a Hadith where the Prophet (SAW) observed a Sahabi's action without objecting is Hadees-e-Taqriri. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, hadith terminology classification.

questions.text: What does Hadith-e-Qudsi refer to?
questions.explanation: Hadith-e-Qudsi refers to the words of Allah conveyed by the Prophet (PBUH) in his own wording, distinct from the Quran. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, hadith terminology classification.

questions.text: How many Ahadis were narrated by Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A)?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) narrated a total of 5374 Ahadith, making him the most prolific narrator among the companions. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, introduction to hadith (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: According to which Islamic source is it stated that a person who hoards food for forty days is disassociated from Allah?
questions.explanation: The statement that a person who hoards food for forty days is disassociated from Allah is found in Hadith. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, introduction to hadith.

questions.text: What was the nature of the relationship between Imam Bukhari and Imam Hanbal?
questions.explanation: Imam Bukhari was a student of Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal and studied Hadith under him. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, introduction to hadith.

questions.text: Who is the author of the renowned Islamic book 'Fath al-Bari'?
questions.explanation: The renowned Islamic book 'Fath al-Bari' was authored by Hafiz Ibn Hajar Asqalani. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, introduction to hadith.

questions.text: Who is the author of the renowned Hadith collection 'Al Muwatta'?
questions.explanation: The renowned Hadith collection 'Al Muwatta' was authored by Imam Malik (R.A). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, sihah sitta (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: Who is the author of Sahih Bukhari?
questions.explanation: The author of Sahih Bukhari is Muhammad bin Ismail Bukhari. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, sihah sitta (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: Which book is compiled by Ahmad Bin Shoaib?
questions.explanation: Ahmad Bin Shoaib, famously known as Imam Al-Nisai, compiled Sunan Al Nisai, one of the six authentic Hadith collections (Sihah Sitta). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, sihah sitta (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: The year 206 AH is the birth year of which person?
questions.explanation: Note: Imam Muslim's birth year is given as 204 or 206 AH. The year 206 AH is the birth year of Imam Muslim. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, sihah sitta (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: Who is the compiler of Jami al-Tirmidhi?
questions.explanation: The compiler of Jami al-Tirmidhi is Muhammad bin Isa al-Tirmidhi. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, sihah sitta.

questions.text: Which of the following pairs of Islamic books is not included in the Sahahe Sitta?

options.B: Sunan Abu Dawood, Sunan Ibn Majah

questions.explanation: Sahih Bukhari, Shamail Tirmizi is the pair not included in Sahahe Sitta because Shamail Tirmizi is a separate work by Imam Tirmizi and not part of the six canonical hadith collections. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, sihah sitta.

questions.text: Who is the collector of Sahih Muslim among the Sihah Sitta?
questions.explanation: The collector of Sahih Muslim among the Sihah Sitta is Muslim bin al-Hajjaj. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, sihah sitta.

questions.text: Which is the first authentic book among the Sahih Sittah in Islamic tradition?
questions.explanation: The first authentic book among the Sahih Sittah is Sahih Bukhari, compiled by Imam Muhammad ibn Ismail al-Bukhari (194–256 AH). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, sihah sitta.
